Description: Investigating electrical oscillations of the human brain (EEG) to decode cognitive processes, attention allocation, and motor planning, aiming to develop high-performance brain-computer interfaces (BCIs).
KeyMetrics: ERP components, Event-Related Desynchronization (ERD), Spectral Power Densities

Description: Examining the relationship between cardiac autonomic regulation and cognitive stress, utilizing Heart Rate Variability (HRV) as a primary biomarker for emotional regulation and resilience.
KeyMetrics: RMSSD, High-Frequency Power (HF-HRV), Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia (RSA)

Description: Studying visual attention paths, fixation durations, saccadic movements, and pupil size dynamics to assess mental workload, fatigue, and affective reactions during human-computer interaction.
KeyMetrics: Fixation Density, Saccadic Velocity, Index of Cognitive Activity (ICA)

Description: Measuring skin conductance responses (SCR) and levels (SCL) to track sympathetic nervous system mobilization in response to stressors, cognitive tasks, and emotional stimuli.
KeyMetrics: Phasic Conductance Peaks, Tonic Conductance Level, Electrodermal Recovery Rate
